implementation_summary: Added a Devanagari row (U+0900-U+097F, U+A8E0-U+A8FF) mapping to 'hi' in SCRIPT_TABLE. Marathi shares the script and is not distinguished; the lang attribute stays a hint only. Added a unit test that a Hindi page is 'hi'.

tests_executed.name: identifies the Hindi page (read-only)
tests_executed.command: CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/tests/audit-languages-e2e.test.ts -t "identifies the Hindi page"

evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-language.test.ts: 'a Devanagari (Hindi) page is identified as hi'
risks: Marathi pages will report 'hi'. A real Hindi/Marathi split needs a later decision (e.g. stopword or lang-based tiebreak).
handoff: SCRIPT_TABLE now has Latin, Tamil and Devanagari. Other Indic scripts (te, kn, ml, gu, bn, or, pa, ur) can be added as extra rows.
